params.name: burst_s_per_GiB
params.note: seconds with > 100 MiB/s of writeback per GiB of temp written

params.name: bw_big_MiBps
params.note: dd O_DIRECT 512 MiB reads over SF100 lineitem's files on sdb (hardware.md 6.1)

params.name: clock_GHz_vs_on_cpu
params.note: least squares over 6 runs (slope 1.70 GHz per unit); clamped outside [0.918, 1]; the microbenchmark (docs/7) explains the shape, not this slope

params.name: clock_readback_GHz_vs_on_cpu
params.note: medians per work_mem; clamped outside. Steeper than the scan phase: synchronous waits every 1-2 ms. Q3 x SF1000 (blind, not used): 0.66 -> 2.54 (turbostat)

params.name: kernel_cycles_per_cached_page
params.note: pread of a page from the page cache into shared buffers

params.name: kernel_cycles_per_cpu_s
params.note: kernel work proportional to running time (tick, scheduler); Q1 vs Q6 warm read the same pages

params.name: kernel_cycles_per_device_page
params.note: page read from sdb (readahead, page-cache insert, copy), from a CPU-bound scan of SF100 orders (not a TPC-H query). Same scan warm: 4157; lineitem (> RAM, with reclaim): 13503; Q1 on sda at SF10: 13232. The queries imply 12.5k (Q6) - 12.8k (Q1): +-4 % depends on the code

params.name: mballoc_window_MiB
params.note: ext4 mballoc ext4_mb_normalize_request: a request below 8 MiB is rounded up to an aligned 1/2/4/8 MiB window by file size; the rest stays preallocated for the file

params.name: page_cache_window_MiB
params.note: E4 M1: node 0's file-page capacity under numactl --membind=0 (PostgreSQL's SYSCONF pgnuma), measured as the peak node-0 FilePages while a bound reader streamed 45 GiB (31031 MiB); retention after writing 8 GiB and reading R GiB follows LRU with this capacity (R = 8/16/24/32: 100/100/72/0 % kept). Replaces the Q3 fit 32365 MiB.

params.name: q1.user_cycles_cal
params.note: user-mode cycles of the scale model at SF10, no spill

params.name: q3.bigkeys_spill_factor
params.note: user-mode cycles above the no-spill run at 64MB and 128MB (cost per spilled tuple; the spilled tuple is 4 B wider)

params.name: q3.bigkeys_user_factor
params.note: user-mode cycles of the scale model without spill (work_mem 1GB)

params.name: q3.kernel_cycles_per_temp_page
params.note: writing a temp page into the page cache and reading it back from there

params.name: q3.temp_bytes_ratio
params.note: the planner's widths vs the bytes PostgreSQL writes per spilled tuple

params.name: q3.user_cycles_cal
params.note: user-mode cycles of the scale model at SF10, no spill

params.name: q3.user_cycles_per_spilled_tuple
params.note: least squares over 3 work_mem settings; intercept 5.297e+10 vs no-spill 5.274e+10

params.name: q6.user_cycles_cal
params.note: user-mode cycles of the scale model at SF10, no spill

params.name: readback_cycles_share
params.note: phase-3 cycles / cycles, both without the batch-count and batch-size terms and without the kernel cycles per CPU-second; per run 0.232, 0.231, 0.233, 0.233, 0.232, 0.231, 0.234, 0.233, 0.229

params.name: readback_wait_per_extent_s
params.note: off-CPU time of the read-back / discontinuities in read order, ms: n16_x1 (95): 25.0, 25.5; n512_x1 (2560): 24.0, 25.3; n512_x3 (4073): 24.2, 25.1; n64_x1 (372): 22.0, 23.3. Q3 x SF100 temp files (queries/q3/sf1000/layout_tempfiles.sh, not used): 19-26 ms

params.name: scan_wait_frac
params.note: hardware/clock_state.py scan:X cells: time in pread calls > 0.5 ms / cell time

params.name: spill_read_user_cycles_vs_batch_mib
params.unit: inner MiB per batch (planner widths) -> cycles / spilled tuple
params.note: phase-3 user cycles per spilled tuple minus 64MB's; clamped (larger batches: 0)

params.name: spill_write_user_cycles_vs_nbatch
params.note: phases 1-2 user cycles above 64MB's, per spilled tuple; clamped (N < 64: 0). 8MB: N=512, S=2.2 MiB, U12 620 G, U3 179 G, spilled 415 M; 16MB: N=256, S=4.3 MiB, U12 590 G, U3 193 G, spilled 413 M; 64MB: N=64, S=17.4 MiB, U12 565 G, U3 209 G, spilled 401 M

params.name: start_extents_vs_chunk_MiB
params.note: extents of a file's first window: extents per file - (size - window) / window, 64 files of 40 MiB at 0.1 / 0.2 MiB/s; the point at the window by continuity

params.name: startup_wait_s
params.note: off-CPU time of a CPU-bound cold scan beyond its readahead waits

params.name: user_cycles_per_false_hash_match
params.note: storing, deforming and comparing an inner tuple whose hash equals the probe's; 64MB: 9.0 M matches, 314; 128MB: 9.0 M matches, 237; 1GB: 9.0 M matches, 240

params.name: writeback_expire_s
params.note: vm.dirty_expire_centisecs: dirty data older than this is written back (checked every 5 s)
